# Softmax

$$
p_i=\operatorname{softmax}(z)_i=\frac{e^{z_i}}{\sum_j e^{z_j}}
=\frac{e^{z_i-m}}{\sum_j e^{z_j-m}},
\qquad m=\max_j z_j.
$$ {#eq-softmax}

Prefer @lst-softmax-torch; @lst-softmax-manual and @lst-softmax-lse are pedagogical equivalents.

```{#lst-softmax-torch .python lst-cap="Softmax via torch.nn.functional"}
import torch.nn.functional as F


def stable_softmax(logits: torch.Tensor, dim: int = -1) -> torch.Tensor:
    return F.softmax(logits, dim=dim)
```

```{#lst-softmax-manual .python lst-cap="Manual max-shifted softmax"}
def manual_softmax(logits: torch.Tensor, dim: int = -1) -> torch.Tensor:
    shifted = logits - logits.max(dim=dim, keepdim=True).values
    exp_shifted = torch.exp(shifted)
    return exp_shifted / exp_shifted.sum(dim=dim, keepdim=True)
```

```{#lst-softmax-lse .python lst-cap="Softmax via log-sum-exp"}
def softmax_via_logsumexp(logits: torch.Tensor, dim: int = -1) -> torch.Tensor:
    return torch.exp(logits - torch.logsumexp(logits, dim=dim, keepdim=True))
```

## Jacobian

$$
\frac{\partial p_i}{\partial z_j}=p_i(\delta_{ij}-p_j),
\qquad
J_{\mathrm{softmax}}=\operatorname{diag}(p)-pp^\top.
$$ {#eq-softmax-jac}

@eq-softmax-jac coincides with the Hessian of log-sum-exp (@eq-lse-hess). See @lst-softmax-jac and @lst-softmax-jac-batch.

```{#lst-softmax-jac .python lst-cap="Softmax Jacobian (single vector)"}
def softmax_jacobian(logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """logits: [K] → J[i,j]=∂p_i/∂z_j of shape [K, K]."""
    if logits.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError("Expected a one-dimensional logits tensor.")
    p = torch.softmax(logits, dim=0)
    return torch.diag(p) - torch.outer(p, p)
```

```{#lst-softmax-jac-batch .python lst-cap="Batched softmax Jacobian"}
def batched_softmax_jacobian(logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """logits: [..., K] → [..., K, K]."""
    p = torch.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
    return torch.diag_embed(p) - p.unsqueeze(-1) * p.unsqueeze(-2)
```

## Hessian tensor

Because softmax is vector-valued, its Hessian is a third-order tensor $H_{ijk}=\partial^2 p_i/(\partial z_j\partial z_k)$:

$$
\frac{\partial^2 p_i}{\partial z_j\partial z_k}
=p_i\Bigl[
(\delta_{ik}-p_k)(\delta_{ij}-p_j)-p_j(\delta_{jk}-p_k)
\Bigr].
$$ {#eq-softmax-hess}

Equivalently, for each output $i$,

$$
H^{(i)}=p_i\Bigl[(e_i-p)(e_i-p)^\top-\bigl(\operatorname{diag}(p)-pp^\top\bigr)\Bigr],
$$ {#eq-softmax-hess-slice}

with $e_i$ the $i$-th standard basis vector. Materialising $H$ costs $O(K^3)$; prefer contractions for large $K$ (@lst-softmax-hess).

```{#lst-softmax-hess .python lst-cap="Full analytic softmax Hessian tensor"}
def softmax_hessian(logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """logits: [K] → H[i,j,k]=∂²p_i/(∂z_j ∂z_k) of shape [K, K, K]."""
    if logits.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError("Expected a one-dimensional logits tensor.")
    p = torch.softmax(logits, dim=0)
    k = p.numel()
    eye = torch.eye(k, dtype=p.dtype, device=p.device)
    diff = eye - p.unsqueeze(0)  # δ_ij - p_j
    first = p[:, None, None] * diff[:, :, None] * diff[:, None, :]
    jacobian = torch.diag(p) - torch.outer(p, p)
    return first - p[:, None, None] * jacobian[None, :, :]
```


# Multinomial-logit coordinates

Let $x=(x_1,\ldots,x_K)$ with $x_i>0$ and $\sum_i x_i=1$. With reference category $K$,

$$
\eta_i=\log\Bigl(\frac{x_i}{x_K}\Bigr),\qquad i=1,\ldots,K-1.
$$ {#eq-alr}

## Forward map ($x\mapsto\eta$)

@lst-simplex-to-logits implements @eq-alr; @lst-simplex-to-logits-clamp adds floating-point clamping (a modelling choice: structural zeros should not be treated as tiny positives).

```{#lst-simplex-to-logits .python lst-cap="Baseline multinomial logits from a composition"}
def simplex_to_logits(
    composition: torch.Tensor,
    eps: float | None = None,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """composition: [..., K] → logits [..., K-1] (last category = reference)."""
    if eps is not None:
        composition = composition.clamp_min(eps)
        composition = composition / composition.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    if torch.any(composition <= 0):
        raise ValueError("All components must be strictly positive.")
    log_x = torch.log(composition)
    return log_x[..., :-1] - log_x[..., -1:]
```

```{#lst-simplex-to-logits-clamp .python lst-cap="Clamped simplex-to-logits using torch.finfo"}
def simplex_to_logits_clamped(composition: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    if not composition.is_floating_point():
        composition = composition.float()
    eps = torch.finfo(composition.dtype).tiny
    x = composition.clamp_min(eps)
    x = x / x.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
    log_x = torch.log(x)
    return log_x[..., :-1] - log_x[..., -1:]
```

## Inverse map ($\eta\mapsto x$)

Augment $\tilde\eta=(\eta_1,\ldots,\eta_{K-1},0)$. Then

$$
x=\operatorname{softmax}(\tilde\eta),
\qquad
x_i=\frac{e^{\eta_i}}{1+\sum_{j=1}^{K-1}e^{\eta_j}}\ (i<K),
\qquad
x_K=\frac{1}{1+\sum_{j=1}^{K-1}e^{\eta_j}}.
$$ {#eq-alr-inv}

```{#lst-logits-to-simplex .python lst-cap="Inverse baseline multinomial-logit transform"}
def logits_to_simplex(logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """logits: [..., K-1] → composition [..., K]."""
    reference = torch.zeros_like(logits[..., :1])
    augmented_logits = torch.cat([logits, reference], dim=-1)
    return torch.softmax(augmented_logits, dim=-1)


def logits_to_log_simplex(logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    reference = torch.zeros_like(logits[..., :1])
    augmented_logits = torch.cat([logits, reference], dim=-1)
    return F.log_softmax(augmented_logits, dim=-1)
```

## Derivatives of the inverse map

For $\eta\in\mathbb{R}^{K-1}$ and $a,b\in\{1,\ldots,K-1\}$,

$$
\frac{\partial x_i}{\partial\eta_a}=x_i(\delta_{ia}-x_a),
\qquad
J=\bigl[\operatorname{diag}(x)-xx^\top\bigr]_{:,\,1:(K-1)}.
$$ {#eq-alr-inv-jac}

$$
\frac{\partial^2 x_i}{\partial\eta_a\partial\eta_b}
=x_i\Bigl[
(\delta_{ib}-x_b)(\delta_{ia}-x_a)-x_a(\delta_{ab}-x_b)
\Bigr].
$$ {#eq-alr-inv-hess}

@eq-alr-inv-hess is the softmax Hessian restricted to the first $K-1$ inputs (@lst-alr-jac, @lst-alr-hess).

```{#lst-alr-jac .python lst-cap="Jacobian of logits → simplex"}
def multinomial_logit_jacobian(logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """logits: [K-1] → Jacobian [K, K-1]."""
    x = logits_to_simplex(logits)
    return (torch.diag(x) - torch.outer(x, x))[:, :-1]
```

```{#lst-alr-hess .python lst-cap="Hessian of logits → simplex"}
def multinomial_logit_hessian(logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """logits: [K-1] → Hessian [K, K-1, K-1]."""
    reference = torch.zeros_like(logits[:1])
    augmented = torch.cat([logits, reference])
    return softmax_hessian(augmented)[:, :-1, :-1]
```

## Derivatives of the forward map

Treating $x$ as ambient coordinates (valid tangent directions satisfy $\sum_i\mathrm{d}x_i=0$),

$$
\frac{\partial\eta_i}{\partial x_j}
=\frac{\delta_{ij}}{x_i}-\frac{\delta_{jK}}{x_K},
$$ {#eq-alr-fwd-jac}

$$
\frac{\partial^2\eta_i}{\partial x_j\partial x_k}
=-\frac{\delta_{ij}\delta_{ik}}{x_i^2}
+\frac{\delta_{jK}\delta_{kK}}{x_K^2}.
$$ {#eq-alr-fwd-hess}

```{#lst-alr-fwd-jac .python lst-cap="Ambient Jacobian of simplex → logits"}
def simplex_to_logits_jacobian(composition: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """composition: [K] → Jacobian [K-1, K]."""
    if composition.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError("Expected a one-dimensional composition.")
    if torch.any(composition <= 0):
        raise ValueError("Composition must be strictly positive.")
    k = composition.numel()
    jacobian = torch.zeros(k - 1, k, dtype=composition.dtype, device=composition.device)
    idx = torch.arange(k - 1, device=composition.device)
    jacobian[idx, idx] = 1.0 / composition[:-1]
    jacobian[:, -1] = -1.0 / composition[-1]
    return jacobian
```

```{#lst-alr-fwd-hess .python lst-cap="Ambient Hessian of simplex → logits"}
def simplex_to_logits_hessian(composition: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    """returns H[i,j,k] for η_i with shape [K-1, K, K]."""
    if composition.ndim != 1:
        raise ValueError("Expected a one-dimensional composition.")
    if torch.any(composition <= 0):
        raise ValueError("Composition must be strictly positive.")
    k = composition.numel()
    hessian = torch.zeros(k - 1, k, k, dtype=composition.dtype, device=composition.device)
    idx = torch.arange(k - 1, device=composition.device)
    hessian[idx, idx, idx] = -1.0 / composition[:-1].square()
    hessian[:, -1, -1] = 1.0 / composition[-1].square()
    return hessian
```

# Checking formulae with autodiff

PyTorch `torch.func.jacrev` / `hessian` can validate closed forms ([PyTorch hessian docs](https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/stable/generated/torch.func.hessian.html)). @lst-check-softmax and @lst-check-lse compare analytic and automatic derivatives; @lst-check-alr covers the baseline inverse map.

```{#lst-check-softmax .python lst-cap="Autodiff check for softmax Jacobian and Hessian"}
from torch.func import jacrev, hessian

torch.set_default_dtype(torch.float64)
z = torch.tensor([1.2, -0.4, 0.7], requires_grad=True)

jac_auto = jacrev(lambda value: torch.softmax(value, dim=0))(z)
hess_auto = jacrev(jacrev(lambda value: torch.softmax(value, dim=0)))(z)

print(torch.allclose(jac_auto, softmax_jacobian(z), atol=1e-10))
print(torch.allclose(hess_auto, softmax_hessian(z), atol=1e-10))
```

```{#lst-check-lse .python lst-cap="Autodiff check for log-sum-exp Hessian"}
lse_hess_auto = hessian(lambda value: torch.logsumexp(value, dim=0))(z)
print(torch.allclose(lse_hess_auto, logsumexp_hessian(z), atol=1e-10))
```

```{#lst-check-alr .python lst-cap="Autodiff check for multinomial-logit inverse map"}
eta = torch.tensor([0.4, -1.1], requires_grad=True)
jac_auto = jacrev(logits_to_simplex)(eta)
hess_auto = jacrev(jacrev(logits_to_simplex))(eta)
print(torch.allclose(jac_auto, multinomial_logit_jacobian(eta), atol=1e-10))
print(torch.allclose(hess_auto, multinomial_logit_hessian(eta), atol=1e-10))
```
